scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: The cumulative helper makes separate ACP-backed repair calls with distinct retained inputs and verifies every accepted cumulative corpus at the injected validator. Exact/one-over controls cover retained-input count, aggregate input bytes, and total arguments. The argument case accepts one argument in the first call and reaches three arguments after the second; a fourth argument is refused before another dispatch, validation, or run creation. Each control verifies that the previously retained corpus and digest remain unchanged, accepted source/head are preserved, and no attempt is pending.
